text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
CORN SALE - Taiwan's FGEP corn procurement group bought one 54,000 tonne shipment of U.S. corn at tender on Wednesday from Zennoh for April/May shipment, traders said.

- Korea Feedgrain Purchase Committee bought 52,000 tonnes of corn on Tuesday at $136.95 per tonne, C&F, traders said on Wednesday. Romak sold the corn through private negotiation. Arrival was set for June 30 to the western port of Inchon. They said the corn may be sourced from Argentina since its planned shipment is during the main Argentine export season.

SOYBEAN SALE - Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association's Kaohsiung division bought one 54,000 tonne shipment of U.S. soybeans at a retender on Wednesday from Cargill for March/April, traders said.

- South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp bought 35,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soybeans at a basis price over March futures on the Chicago Board of Trade, a company official said on Wednesday. The company bought the soybeans from Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp with shipment slated for March 1-15 from the U.S. Gulf. Arrival was set for the city of Inchon.

WHEAT SALE - The CCC said it bought 20,500 tonnes of U.S. Northern Spring/Dark Northern Spring wheat for export to Mozambique. The wheat was purchased at $169.32 a tonne, FOB, from Peavey Company out of Paulina, La. Delivery was slated for March 5-31 delivery, it said.

- The Taiwan Flour Mills Association on Wednesday bought 26,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat from Mitsui at a tender, traders said. The shipment, consisting of Dark Northern Spring, Hard Red Winter and White Wheat, is slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest.
CORN TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday invited tenders for the supply of 18,000 tonnes of maize, with shipment in March 1997. Tenders close on February 25, the commission said.

WHEAT TENDER - The CCC said it seeks a total of 10,530 tonnes U.S. hard red wheat under its export program to Bangladesh. The wheat was divided into two offers. One was for 5,870 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat and the other was for 4,660 tonnes HRW or hard red spring wheat. Shipment period for both was for March 15-April 10. Offers were due on February 26.

MARKET TALK - Southeast Asian domestic grain and oilseed prices were largely steady in a subdued market this week as firms got back to business after the long Chinese New Year and Hari Raya holidays, traders said on Wednesday.
... South Africa has agreed to accept U.S. wheat from karnal bunt quarantine areas if it has twice tested negative for the fungus, U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said.
... South Africa's Maize Board said on Wednesday it had issued export permits to private traders covering 26,250 tonnes of white maize for shipment in the months of February to end-April.
... USDA said Jamaica was authorized to buy $10 million worth of U.S. rice under Public Law 480, Title I.
